Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: CRED's post-purchase promo card - on the order-success page a collapsed promo band auto-expands into a tall groupbuy panel, its logo and member avatars staggering in, pushing the cards below down with a spring.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
CRED order-success page, white: "no more long distance" header, a "1 product purchased" card, then a promo card - collapsed: a slim purple band with a label; expanded: a tall purple panel with the "groupbuy" diamond logo and wordmark, a row of member avatars, and copy - above a dark green "level 2 unlocked" card. A "Continue shopping" button pins the bottom.

## Motion spec
Pattern: auto-expanding promo card with staggered interior reveal.
- ~600ms after the page settles, the promo card's height grows from band to panel (spring ~280/20, slight overshoot) - everything below translates down with it 1:1, keeping gaps constant.
- Inside the new space: the diamond logo draws/scales in first (scale 0 -> 1, spring ~400/15, rotateZ -90 -> 0), then the "groupbuy" wordmark fades up (translateY 10 -> 0, 250ms).
- The member avatars pop in one by one (scale 0 -> 1, spring ~450/18, 70ms stagger) sliding into their overlapping row; a count badge lands last (scale pop, 150ms).
- The card's purple deepens slightly as it expands (color tween over the spring).
- Tap anywhere on the panel to collapse it back (same spring reversed); it re-expands on the next visit.

## Calibration
- The expansion must read as the card opening, not the page scrolling - content above never moves.
- The purple panel is the only saturated block on the page; keep neighboring cards muted.

## Reduced motion
Card height animates 250ms linear; interior elements fade in together (200ms).

## Don't miss
- The green "level 2 unlocked" card below never changes size - it just rides the push.
- The logo's rotational entry is the signature - don't flatten it to a fade.
